name: Average Claim Success Score
query:
select
	cl.scheme,
	cl.provider,
	count(*) as evaluations,
	round(avg(e.overall_score), 2) as avg_score,
	sum(case when e.overall_status = 'Eligible' then 1 else 0 end) as eligible_count,
	sum(case when e.overall_status = 'Not Eligible' then 1 else 0 end) as not_eligible_count
from `tabClaim Eligibility Evaluation` e
left join `tabInsurance Claim` cl on cl.name = e.insurance_claim
group by cl.scheme, cl.provider
order by avg_score desc
